name: Enchanted Gaea Seeds
summary: At Sun Rock Retreat, Enchanted Gaea Seeds are bound for the Charred Vale. Druidic magic helps them take root in ash-choked soil and begin to heal Kalimdor's ravaged land.

sections.title: A Spark in the Ashes
sections.body: Horde druids are working to heal the deep scars across Stonetalon Mountains. At Sun Rock Retreat, Tammra Windfield enchants raw Gaea Seeds to endure corruption and elemental blight. Planted in fertile dirt mounds beneath the Charred Vale's soot, they can take root in harsh ground. Yet hostile fire elementals and invasive harpies still rule the vale.

sections.title: The Promise of Renewal
sections.body: The seeds are part of the struggle for Stonetalon's future. Their enchanted husks resist lingering corruption and give native plants a foothold. That returning growth is meant to soothe agitated fire elementals, crowd out feral harpies, and counter the deforestation wrought by the Venture Company's relentless logging.

faq.q: What are Enchanted Gaea Seeds used for?
aliases: what do enchanted gaea seeds do
faq.answer: Plant Enchanted Gaea Seeds in fertile dirt mounds in the Charred Vale. They are meant to grow resilient plants that resist corruption and begin healing land scarred by fire and warfare.

faq.q: Who created or enchanted these seeds?
faq.answer: Raw Gaea Seeds are gathered in the surrounding wilderness and brought to Tammra Windfield at Sun Rock Retreat. She enchants them to help them survive the Charred Vale's hostile, ash-laden soil.

faq.q: Why must they be planted in the Charred Vale?
faq.answer: The Charred Vale is where ecological destruction has struck Stonetalon Mountains hardest. Angry fire elementals and harpies overrun it, and planting the seeds in surviving soil mounds brings new life meant to soothe the region's turmoil.

faq.q: What threats face the planted seeds?
faq.answer: Hostile fire elementals born of the blaze and aggressive Bloodfury harpies nesting in the ruins threaten the planted seeds. The Venture Company's nearby operations bring further industrial destruction.

angles.text: As a druid, you help nurture rebirth and coax resilient life back into land consumed by ruin and wildfire.
As one of the Shu'halo of Sun Rock Retreat, you plant enchanted seeds as spiritual stewardship, honoring the Earth Mother and reclaiming wounded land.
